customManagers.description: Images pinned as tag@digest inside the inline compose YAML of these Puppet manifests; Renovate's compose manager only reads compose files.

Version ARGs in services/caddy-poc/Dockerfile carry a '# renovate:' comment. Base image digests are not bumped by this rule: a new Caddy tag still builds with the pinned toolchain image, and digests are refreshed by hand.

packageRules.description: ziti/tofu runs on OpenTofu (TOFU_IMAGE in scripts/ziti-tofu.sh, 1.13.x), but Renovate reads required_version as HashiCorp Terraform and proposed ~> 1.17.0 (#656), which OpenTofu 1.13 refuses. required_version moves by hand with TOFU_IMAGE.

Digest and patch updates of container images and Actions merge themselves once the required checks pass (owner decision 2026-11-21): ten unmerged PRs had hit the PR limit and held back image rebuilds with fixes for actively exploited CVEs. Merging deploys nothing by itself; hosts pick it up at their next deploy request or Saturday's scheduled run. Not Go modules: a go.mod change needs the committed binaries rebuilt (scripts/service-binary.sh), which Renovate cannot do. platformAutomerge is off because the repo does not allow GitHub auto-merge; Renovate merges the green PR itself.
DefectDojo's django and nginx images are one release and must move together: on 2026-11-24 only django was bumped (3.5.103 -> 3.5.200, #708).
Keep OpenVox Forge updates separate and manually reviewed

Don't let Renovate bump go.mod's own `go` directive - it's pinned to match CI's toolchain (see .github/workflows), and Renovate bumping it alongside an unrelated dependency update breaks the build (seen live 2026-09-08, PR #311: x/sync bump silently carried go 1.25.2 -> 1.26.0). Renovate 44 dropped the golang-version manager; the directive is now the gomod dependency of depType golang (an unknown manager name made the whole config invalid, 2026-11-16 to 11-21, issue #607).

go.socket.io 0.2.0 makes provision-kuma hang on login against a fresh Kuma 2.5.7 (autosetup), tested 2026-10-24 on a throwaway container; the Kuma client lives in tools/thirdparty and tools/go.mod replaces it, so its version line is never used

sdk-golang 1.9.x is retracted by its maintainers ("Published from main before the module moved to github.com/openziti/sdk-golang/v2; the supported v1 line is 1.8.x"), and Renovate proposed 1.9.1 anyway (#657, closed 2026-11-22). Stay on 1.8.x; the move to /v2 is its own change.
